defs.def: the way in which a person or a group of people lives and works 生活方式；工作方式

ex.s: “We could plant any trees we want to, if we just rethink our car-centric lifestyle,” she said.
ex.t: “只要我们重新思考以汽车为中心的生活方式，我们想种什么树都可以，”她说。

ex.s: ·Healthy Living: Empowering you to make healthy decisions in such areas as nutrition and emotional well-being, and lead healthy lifestyles
ex.t: 这可能导致人类不会犯的那类错误。

ex.s: You can view these practices as a toolbox meant to aid your efforts to build a minimalist lifestyle that words for your particular circumstances.
ex.t: 你可以把这些练习看作一个工具箱，用来帮助你打造适合自己特定情况的极简生活方式。

ex.s: Advocating a simple digital lifestyle.
ex.t: 倡导简单的数字生活方式。

ex.s: The program aims to help students develop science skills, environmental awareness, and healthy lifestyles.
ex.t: 该项目旨在帮助学生培养科学技能、环境意识和健康的生活方式。

ex.s: Chances are that if you’re looking to live a more sustainable lifestyle, not everyone around you will be ready to jump on that bandwagon.
ex.t: 很可能，如果你想过上更可持续的生活，你周围并非所有人都会准备好跟上这股潮流。

ex.s: I experienced this when I started switching to a zero waste lifestyle five years ago, as I was living with my parents, and I continue to experience this with my husband, as he is not completely zero waste like me.
ex.t: 五年前我刚开始转向零废弃生活方式时就有这种体会，那时我和父母同住；现在和丈夫在一起也继续有这种体会，因为他不像我那样完全零废弃。

ex.s: Zero waste was a radical lifestyle movement a few years back.
ex.t: 零浪费在几年前还是一场激进的生活方式运动。

ex.s: As you make your lifestyle changes, you may find yourself wanting to speak up for yourself if others comment on what you’re doing, which can turn itself into a whole household debate.
ex.t: 当你做出生活方式改变时，如果别人评论你的做法，你可能会想为自己发声，这可能演变成全家的一场争论。

ex.s: How to live a zero waste lifestyle in a household.
ex.t: 如何在一个家庭里过零浪费的生活。

ex.s: Lifestyles in different countries.
ex.t: 不同国家的生活方式。

ex.s: They first found 10 overweight and inactive but otherwise healthy young men, whose lifestyles are, for better and worse, representative of those of most of us.
ex.t: 他们首先找到了10名超重且不爱运动但其他方面健康的年轻男性，他们的生活方式无论好坏都代表了我们大多数人的生活方式。

ex.s: Their lifestyles were typical of ordinary people.
ex.t: 他们的生活方式是普通人的典型。

ex.s: Lifestyle is not as important as morning exercise.
ex.t: 生活方式不如晨练重要。

ex.s: Peoples lifestyles are reflected in languages
ex.t: 人们的生活方式反映在语言中

ex.s: It is  70  (certain) fun but the lifestyle is a little unreal.
ex.t: 这当然____（确）很有趣，但这种生活方式有点不真实。

ex.s: We put this to the test by asking five people to open their fridge doors and talk about their lifestyles.
ex.t: 我们请了五个人打开冰箱门谈论他们的生活方式来验证这一点。

ex.s: If we have children, I want to bring them up just like us, but my husbands says that everyone should be able to make their own lifestyle choices.
ex.t: 如果我们有孩子，我想把他们抚养得和我们一样，但我丈夫说，每个人都应能作出自己的生活方式选择。

ex.s: Explain the possible problems with their lifestyles.
ex.t: 解释他们生活方式中可能存在的问题。

ex.s: Make suggestions about how they can improve their lifestyles.
ex.t: 就如何改善他们的生活方式提出建议。
